# Python Desktop Application Workspace

- This workspace is for small Python office apps, utilities, and mini games. For a new desktop GUI prefer PyQt6; use SQLite only when the app needs local relational persistence. Choose a visual direction suited to the audience, with accessible colors, keyboard controls, and a usable first screen.
- For an app brief or planned feature, follow the [planning workflow](instructions/planning-workflow.instructions.md). Produce `PLAN.md`, `MILESTONES.md`, and `HANDOFF.md` before application code. Once milestones are clear, the user-facing coordinator recommends and resolves the `commit`, `push`, and `pr` switches in one interactive checkpoint unless already specified. Keep the artifacts current and require a separate `REVIEW.md` before declaring the solution independently reviewed.
- Plan, implement, and verify the work, then request an independent review when a separate reviewer is available. Resolve and record the Git switches after planning, fix blocking findings, retest, and request a new review before authorized final publication. Record the final evidence and Git results in `MILESTONES.md` and `HANDOFF.md`. Do not treat the implementer's self-review as independent.
- If independent review is unavailable, state that it is pending. Never substitute self-review for a reviewer verdict. Tool approvals and explicit user constraints still apply. For a plan-only or review-only request, run only the corresponding stage. Do not start the app workflow for questions or customization maintenance.
